clips.title: The story
paras: After an adventurer's great help, Orokk Omosh shares a family tradition in Orgrimmar. The veteran blacksmith brushes off his tears as soot, then performs the Omosh dance of joy to pass down an unusual piece of family heritage.

Near Orgrimmar's scorching forge, Orokk Omosh is known for heavy hammer blows, not tears. The burly blacksmith has received great help from you, and the kindness overwhelms him. He stubbornly blames a stray bit of soot in his eye rather than admit he is weeping.

Before you part, Orokk says he must share one last secret of the Omosh family. He performs the vigorous, exhausting Omosh dance of joy for his apprentice, then teaches the apprentice to strike with an iron fist.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Orokk is not crying, friend. Soot is in eye.
There is one last Omosh family secret Orokk will teach you. Orokk will die happy, thanks to friend.
Learn Omosh dance of joy and then you learn fist of iron!

clips.title: Completion
paras: It has been a very long time since Orokk has done the Omosh dance of joy. Learn now, friend!
